title: NYC Bus - TRAINING (headway waits)
note: Up to 10000 rows with the smallest SHA-256 Record ID hashes (reproducible, station-agnostic). Headway-derived expected stop wait (minutes): exact mean, over the local hour, of time until the next recorded passage of the passenger's route at the same stop; averaged over routes serving the stop. Passages interpolated from MTA bus GTFS-realtime positions (TransitLab archive); random passenger arrival assumed; capacity/denied boarding not represented. Not an individually measured passenger wait.

title: NYC Bus - TRAINING 2,000 (quick, headway waits)
note: The 2,000 rows of the Bus training file with the smallest SHA-256 Record ID hashes (same columns and waiting-time definition). Trains faster than the full 10,000-row file, for demonstrations on the hosted server. Results differ from the thesis run, which used 10,000 rows. Predict with the 100- and 50-row prediction sets; the 200-row prediction test includes stations that need the 10,000-row model.

title: NYC Bus - PREDICTION TEST (200 rows, blank waits)
note: 200 NYC bus stop-hours not in the training file, with Actual Waiting Time left blank for Test & Predict. The real waits are in NYC_BUS_PREDICTION_TEST_200_answers.csv.

title: NYC Bus - PREDICTION SET (100 rows, blank waits)
note: 100 NYC bus stop-hours not in the training file or the 200-row prediction test, from stations used to fit both the 2,000-row and the 10,000-row models (works with either), with Actual Waiting Time left blank for Test & Predict. The real waits are in data/samples/NYC_BUS_PREDICTION_SET_100_answers.csv.

title: NYC Bus - PREDICTION SET (50 rows, blank waits)
note: 50 NYC bus stop-hours not in the training file or the 200-row prediction test, from stations used to fit both the 2,000-row and the 10,000-row models (works with either), with Actual Waiting Time left blank for Test & Predict. title: NYC Train - TRAINING (headway waits)
note: Up to 10000 rows with the smallest SHA-256 Record ID hashes (reproducible, station-agnostic). Headway-derived expected platform wait (minutes): exact mean, over the local hour, of time until the next recorded departure of the passenger's route at the same platform direction; averaged over route-directions serving the complex. Observed departures (TransitLab/MTA GTFS-realtime), random passenger arrival assumed; capacity/denied boarding not represented. Not an individually measured passenger wait.
